articles.title: UN Report: U.S. Climate Pollution Rose Sharply Last Year
articles.summary: A UN report says the U.S. was the only major economy where climate pollution rose sharply last year; the U.S. government disagrees with the report.

articles.title: FAA Approves Boeing's Biggest 737 Max Jet After Years of Delays
articles.summary: The FAA approved Boeing's 737 Max 10, the largest 737 Max jet, for passenger service after nearly a decade of delays.

articles.title: Lawsuit Challenges Trump's Tariffs on Canadian Goods
articles.summary: A U.S. food importer has sued over Trump's tariffs on Canadian goods, saying a 1930 trade law was used beyond the president's power.
